summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Settings page with focus on new Daily Learning Goal slider. All 9 sections accessible and functional.

Settings_Navigation.details: All 9 navigation sections accessible: Profile, Personal Info, Learning, Notifications, Display, Security, Privacy, Parental Controls, Account Actions

Daily_Learning_Goal_Slider.details: Slider component works correctly. Range: 5-60 minutes with step of 5. Updates state on interaction. Shows contextual messages: '🌱 Quick daily practice' (≤10), '📖 Good learning habit' (≤20), '🔥 Serious learner!' (≤40), '🏆 Power learner mode!' (>40)

Profile_Section.details: Name input (data-testid='name-input') works. Avatar picker button accessible. User ID displayed. Manage Profiles section visible.

Personal_Info_Section.details: DOB input (data-testid='dob-input'), Life Stage select (data-testid='life-stage-select'), Occupation select (data-testid='occupation-select') all functional.

Learning_Section.details: Language select, Experience select, Daily Goal slider, Enable Hints toggle, Financial Goals section all present and functional.

Notifications_Section.details: Master toggle, Reminder time input, Achievement Alerts, Milestone Celebrations, Streak Reminders, Weekly Progress Email toggles all functional.

Display_Section.details: Dark Mode toggle, Text Size buttons (Small/Medium/Large/Extra Large), Font Style picker, High Contrast toggle, Reduce Animations toggle all present.

Security_Section.details: 3 password fields (current, new, confirm), Update Password button present. Two-Factor Authentication shows 'Coming Soon'.

Privacy_Section.details: Profile Visible, Share Progress, Allow Analytics toggles present. Data Retention dropdown, Export Data button functional.

Parental_Controls_Section.details: Shows 'Coming Soon' placeholder with Phase 1 and Phase 2 feature roadmap. MOCKED - no backend functionality.

Account_Actions_Section.details: Reset Learning Progress button and Delete My Account button present with appropriate warnings.

Save_Settings_Functionality.details: Save Changes button triggers PUT /api/settings. Success message '✅ Settings saved successfully!' displayed in banner.
